featured_reviews.name: Shreya Wagherkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (3.5/5)

I recently ordered a Ninja Box from CaterNinja for a house party of around 15–20 people, and my experience was a mix of highs and lows.

Starting with the pre-sales experience, I wasn’t particularly happy with the customer service. As a first-time customer, I expected a bit more effort towards relationship-building and understanding my requirements. Their preferred mode of communication was text, but some discussions are simply easier over a phone call. Despite repeatedly requesting a callback, that never happened.

I also understand that sales teams are under pressure to close deals quickly, but there is a fine line between being proactive and making a customer feel pressured. At times, the interaction felt a bit pushy, and I wasn’t left with the best impression by the end of the booking process.

That said, the after-sales experience was excellent. The coordination between the kitchen and delivery team was smooth, and I especially appreciated receiving a call to check for allergies and taste preferences before preparation. It’s a small touch, but it shows attention to detail.

The delivery was completely hassle-free. No unnecessary calls from delivery executives, everything arrived on time, and the staff was polite and professional throughout.

Now, the most important part—the food.

The quantity was spot on. There was more than enough food for everyone without ending up with excessive wastage. The starters, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian, were absolutely fantastic. They were easily the highlight of the meal and were loved by all the guests. CaterNinja really seems to excel in this department.

The main course, however, was slightly underwhelming. It wasn’t bad by any means, but it didn’t quite deliver the same impact as the starters.

One thing worth noting: the food is best consumed within about 4 hours of delivery. Beyond that, the quality starts to deteriorate. So if you’re planning a house party with a significantly delayed dinner schedule, it’s something to keep in mind.

Overall, a good experience with great food, smooth execution, and excellent after-sales service. If the pre-sales customer experience and main course offerings improve, it would easily be a higher-rated experience.

Was it worth the price?

Not quite.

While the starters were genuinely excellent and easily the strongest part of the meal, the main course didn’t quite justify the premium pricing. For the amount paid, I expected the same level of quality and impact throughout the menu. The food was good overall, but the main course fell short of delivering the value I was hoping for.

If you’re ordering primarily for the starters and convenience, CaterNinja does a great job. But from a pure value-for-money perspective, there’s definitely room for improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Nabil Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unsafe Food, Policy-Based Excuses Instead of Accountability
This was our first and extremely disappointing experience with CaterNinja.
We placed a bulk order worth ₹8,000, which included multiple appetizers, rice items, and desserts for a group event. Initially, we noticed a bad smell from the veg Schezwan rice. Later, when the remaining food was properly packed and stored in the refrigerator to consume the next day, every single item—including chicken fried rice, chicken seekh kebab, achari chicken tikka, kalmi chicken tikka, paneer items, and mushrooms—developed a foul smell and became completely inedible. We had no option but to throw everything away.
Any freshly cooked food does not spoil overnight when stored correctly. This clearly indicates that the food delivered was not freshly prepared, raising serious food safety concerns, especially with cooked rice and poultry.
What is more disappointing is CaterNinja’s response. Instead of addressing the quality and safety issue, they stated that:
Food was “freshly prepared” as per internal policy
Issues must be reported within 2 hours to be considered
Since no report was received within that time, they cannot assess the claim
This response completely ignores the fact that:
Food quality issues often become evident only after consumption or later storage
During a live event, it is not always practical to investigate and report immediately
Unsafe food cannot be justified or dismissed based on a time window
They offered only a discount on the next order, which is unacceptable when unsafe food worth ₹8,000 had to be discarded.
Adding to this, after delivery, the sales executive stopped answering calls (messages still showed as delivered), which reflects a lack of accountability. After this incident, I also noticed other customer reviews mentioning spoiled food, indicating this may not be an isolated case.
CaterNinja relies heavily on policy-based replies rather than taking responsibility for food safety. I strongly do NOT recommend CaterNinja, especially for bulk or party orders where hygiene, freshness, and trust are critical.

Terrible staff service. Was seated at the table and the waiter banged the serving plate on my head and other guests seated at the same table whilst serving food. Extremely unprofessional.

featured_reviews.name: Shazaan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had got dinner prepared for a house party from Brite Caterers (Mr. Faiyaz) on 26th Oct 2024.
Food quantity was inadequate as per the number of guests finalised - which we informed their staff and owner immediately. They all agreed that the quantity was not adequate for the decided number of people and there genuinely was a shortage in the quantity (we have cctv footage of the entire incident and conversation). However, instead of apologising, they later began insisting that food was enough for everyone and to pay up in full (which we did) even though the shortage of food was accepted from their end earlier. Beware of their fraudulent tactics. We as hosts had to face immense embarrassment in front of guests due to food shortage and bad service.

Food taste was below average at best, while some items were utterly disliked by almost all guests (Chicken Kashmiri and Mandi Rice).
Their service staff keep insisting on tips infront of guests which is a big turn off. Overall an extremely BAD experience, be it quantity, taste or service.

We have placed orders to Brite Caterers for 3 weddings earlier (April 2017, May 2017 and Jan 2018) and also a house party (Sep 2019). We had a good experience then. However their quality, service, taste and quantity has SEVERELY deteriorated since. Have recently attended a couple of weddings with Brite serving food and have observed this inconsistent taste and service there too.

I do not post negative reviews, however anyone planning to opt for Brite Caterers has to be informed before spending their money here to avoid embarrassment in front of their guests and face what we as hosts faced. I hope no one has to face the same.

Please opt for Jaffer Bhai’s Catering instead for peace of mind and value for money and to save yourselves from a horrible experience, embarrassment, and regret.
Brite Caterers is just not worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: This air conditioned banquet is located on the fourth floor of this sports complex. It is a really nice and well lit Banquet Hall. They have a permanent stage set up at 1 end of the banquet. There are also changing rooms behind the stage. Clean washrooms both for men and women are maintained here. The service and staff are good. The food is mostly served during an event on the floor above the Banquet Hall. That is the fifth floor. Parking here can be an issue as they don't have a dedicated parking lot. You will need to find Street parking which is difficult.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had my wedding at Rhythm Banquets, and I cannot express how grateful I am for the exceptional service we received. From start to finish, the staff made everything effortless, allowing us to focus on enjoying our special day. Especially Deepak Sir and Rashmi Ma'am were instrumental in the success of our wedding. Their attention to detail and passion for their work truly stood out. They organized everything perfectly, ensuring that every aspect of the celebration met our expectations and beyond. It felt as they were part of our family, treating our wedding as if it were their own.
In addition to their outstanding coordination, they went above and beyond by providing complimentary items that added a special touch to our event. It’s this level of care that creates a unique connection, and I now feel like they are a part of my family.
Overall, our wedding at Rhythm Banquets turned out to be exactly what I wished for, thanks to the amazing team. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a venue that combines professionalism with heartfelt service.
Thank you, Rhythm Banquets, for making our wedding day the best it could be!
